title: Return a greeting
summary: Fastify: Return a greeting. Change the returned greeting.
introduction: A Fastify handler can return a value directly. Open GET /. Read the example, then check the result.

blocks.text: In a practice folder run npm init -y and npm install fastify@5. Save one example as server.mjs and run node server.mjs. Use http://127.0.0.1:3000 and stop each server before the next example.

blocks.title: Return a greeting

blocks.text: Fastify sends the returned string as the route response. async lets the handler return through a promise.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Return the result or send it with reply; do not do both.
